req.title: Create requires title
req.statement: The system shall render 'Title is required.' when POST /create omits the title field.

doc.reasoning: R-FLASKR-016 requires that POST /create returns HTTP 2xx with 'Title is required.' in the response body when the title field is omitted. Three tests are designed: (1) positive — logged-in user POSTs with a valid title and body, confirming successful redirect (no error); (2) negative — logged-in user POSTs with title omitted entirely, confirming 'Title is required.' appears in the 200 response; (3) boundary — logged-in user POSTs with title as empty string (the exact boundary between present and absent), confirming the same error message. Each test uses pre-loaded credentials (Rahul/stone, user id=1) and is fully self-contained with its own temp DB and app instance.

tests.name: test_create_with_valid_title_succeeds
preconditions: App is initialised with a fresh temp database seeded with pre-loaded rows
User 'Rahul' (id=1) is logged in via POST /auth/login
POST /create is sent with non-empty title and body
actions: Create app with TESTING=True and temp DATABASE
POST /create with title='My Valid Title', body='Some body text'
expected: Response status code is 302 (redirect to index)
Response does NOT contain 'Title is required.'
trace: R-FLASKR-016 — positive path: valid title must NOT trigger the error message
Catches mutations that always flash the error or invert the title check
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp()
os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

# Log in as Rahul
login_r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
assert login_r.status_code == 302, f'Login failed: {login_r.status_code}'

# POST /create with a valid title
create_r = client.post('/create', data={'title': 'My Valid Title', 'body': 'Some body text'})
assert create_r.status_code == 302, f'Expected redirect, got {create_r.status_code}'
assert b'Title is required.' not in create_r.data

os.unlink(path)
